text: 从国家发展改革委获悉，今日24时国内成品油调价窗口将开启。据国家发展改革委价格监测中心监测，本轮成品油调价周期内（7月3日24时——7月17日24时），国际油价震荡上涨。 7月17日24时起，国内汽、柴油零售限价每吨分别上调300元和290元。全国平均来看，92号汽油、95号汽油和0号柴油每升分别上调0.24元、0.25元、0.25元。(央视新闻)
text_en: Learned from the NDRC that the window for adjusting domestic refined oil product prices will open at 24:00 today. According to monitoring by the Price Monitoring Center of the NDRC, international oil prices rose with fluctuations during this adjustment cycle (from 24:00 on July 3 to 24:00 on July 17). From 24:00 on July 17, domestic retail price caps for gasoline and diesel will be raised by RMB 300 and RMB 290 per ton, respectively. Nationwide average, 92 RON gasoline, 95 RON gasoline, and 0 diesel will increase by RMB 0.24, RMB 0.25, and RMB 0.25 per liter, respectively. (CCTV News)
